decision: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
event_name: Date 28 April 2019 Time 14:34 2019 AZERBAIJAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 April 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 33), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: The rear heave spring has been replaced with one of a different specification and changes have been made to the setup of the suspension.
offence: Breach of Article 34.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
reason: The stewards reviewed the evidence from the Technical Delegate and determined that as the rear heave spring is different from the part originally used in qualifying and changes have been made to the setup of the suspension the competitor is required to start from the pit lane.
rules_referenced: Article 34.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: Offence Car 88 Suspension Setup Change
